scope: current client-v2 and auth implementation audit; no external client onboarded

clean_empty_state.finding: Supabase list loaders previously fell back to synthetic tasks/scores on successful empty results; this phase removes those fallbacks for live reads.

data_isolation.finding: Queries are client_id scoped in the live adapter; a clean-account browser proof still requires an authenticated test account and live flag.

visual_quality.finding: Existing audit baseline is 35/100; client-v2 design system exists but no current rendered first-impression certification was completed in this session.

mobile.finding: Responsive tokens/components exist; actual viewport screenshots remain required.
